author: The Babylon Bee
description: Following the historic announcement of Robert Pattinson as the next James Bond, Amazon MGM Studios teased plans for a special "DK Mode" version of the film where every actor will have an oversized head and giant arms to mimic the design of Nintendo's Donkey Kong.
title: New James Bond To Feature Special 'DK Mode' Edition Only In Theaters

author: The Babylon Bee
description:
The official Grand Faith Auto game launch trailer. It's the new hit video game everyone's been waiting to play for years. It's an open world and a narrow path. 

New Mercy, USA.

The deck has always been stacked against you in New Mercy and the forces of Hell have been relentless, forcing you to rely on God ever harder. Preach the word, do good works, and defeat the forces of Hell.

This trailer footage was captured entirely in-game from a 3DO.

Grand Faith Auto arrives November 18. Just remember that Grand Faith Auto is free, while Grand Theft Auto VI will cost your eternal soul (plus $80).

No joke. For real. Just go to http://babylonbee.com/grand-faith-auto
title: Grand Faith Auto Launch Trailer - The Hit New Video Game Everyone's Been Waiting Years To Play
